title: Gentle air: /θ/
goal: Practise /θ/ and use it in a short, understandable exchange.
cue: Place your tongue tip lightly at or just between your teeth. Let air flow without voice. Do not bite or force the tongue forward.
spelling: th can represent /θ/, as in thin. It can also represent a voiced sound, introduced next.

articulation.label: thin
articulation.alt: thin: /θ/ → /ɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /θ/: Tongue tip lightly at or between the teeth.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
